## 13. Sub-$15 plans and one-time credit packs — the critical answer
**No paid plan under $15/month among the six**, with two edge cases:

| Product | Cheapest paid | Under $15/mo? |
|---|---|---|
| Lovable | Pro $20–25/mo | No |
| Bolt | Pro $25/mo | No |
| v0 | Plus $30/user/mo (Premium $20 closed to new users) | No |
| Replit | Core $20/mo annual ($25 monthly) | No |
| Base44 | Starter $16/mo (annualized) | No — barely |
| Hostinger Horizons | Explorer $6.99/mo **annual only** ($9.99 month-to-month) | **Yes on annual, no on monthly** |

**Non-subscription one-time credit packs — essentially none of them offer this:**
- **Lovable**: top-ups **require an active Pro or Business plan**. $0.30/credit (Pro), $0.60 (Business), 12-month expiry, 50-credit increments.
- **Bolt**: rolled-over and purchased tokens are only accessible **while a paid subscription is active** — no standalone pack.
- **v0**: additional credits purchasable **only on Premium/Plus/Business**. Purchased credits expire 1 year.
- **Replit**: free Starter gets daily credits; beyond plan credits it's pay-as-you-go/top-up **on top of a plan**. No plan-free pack.
- **Base44**: top-ups exist mid-cycle, but tied to an existing plan.
- **Hostinger Horizons**: the **only one with an official statement that top-ups "don't require an additional subscription"** (support doc 11136677), though Explorer-tier users reportedly cannot top up, and it still presumes a Hostinger plan. Top-up credits expire after 3 months.
- Outside the six: **Rocket.new explicitly requires an active paid subscription** to buy credits. **Framer** sells add-on credits but only alongside a plan.

**Bottom line for positioning**: every major competitor is subscription-gated. There is no true pay-once, no-recurring-fee credit pack in this market — the closest is Hostinger's top-up language, and it is still layered on a hosting subscription.
